name: Noble Deaths
summary: In Southshore, Magistrate Henry Maleb fears the Syndicate means ruin for the town. He sends you north to Strahnbrad's ruins in the Alterac Mountains, where he believes its leaders have their headquarters.

sections.title: Hunting the Syndicate's Leaders
sections.body:
After Foreboding Plans, Magistrate Henry Maleb wants the Syndicate's leaders struck down before their plans come to pass. Its cutthroats answer to former Alterac nobles, who may hide among ordinary agents. Their signet rings mark them out. Maleb asks you to bring him seven Alterac signet rings in Southshore.

He believes the Syndicate has made its headquarters among Strahnbrad's ruins, north in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: Maleb's Hope
sections.body: Maleb believes the Syndicate could no longer act with decision without its nobility. He thinks it would be reduced to common thugs.

faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore sends you north to strike at the leaders behind the Syndicate.

faq.q: Where are the Syndicate nobles located?
faq.answer: Maleb believes the Syndicate has made its headquarters among Strahnbrad's ruins, north in the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: How can you tell the nobles apart from ordinary Syndicate members?
faq.answer: The nobles may hide among ordinary Syndicate agents, but their signet rings mark them out.
